locale_code.description: The language this catalogue is written in, as a BCP-47 code. Read by the code to keep Intl.DisplayNames and plural rules on the catalogue's language - must equal the directory name.

extension_description.message: Learn a language while reading the web. Translation, vocabulary and an offline reading list - nothing you read leaves your device.

pair_label.description: How a translation direction reads on screen. Languages whose grammar would bend the names use an arrow instead of a word.

open_reader.message: Read this page in the reader

error_engine_missing.message: No translation engine yet - this build cannot translate.

error_model_missing.message: No model for this language pair on this device - download or add one in the settings.

error_unsupported_pair.message: No model exists for this language pair.

error_too_long.message: That selection is too long to translate.

error_no_page.message: There is no page to read here - open an article and press the button again.

error_unknown_message.message: The extension sent a request it does not understand.

error_internal.message: Something went wrong inside the extension.

popup_site_toggle_title.message: Whether re/read runs on this site

popup_no_page.message: re/read does not work on this page.

reader_no_article.message: There was no article to find on that page.

reader_list_write_failed.message: The reading list could not be written.

reader_empty_none.message: Nothing is saved yet - open an article in the reader and press "$BUTTON$". A saved page stays on this device and opens without a connection.
reader_empty_none.description: The button quoted is reader_save, passed in so the two can never drift apart.

reader_empty_all_read.message: Nothing left to read - everything saved is marked as read.

reader_empty_none_read.message: Nothing is marked as read yet.

reader_library_note.message: Everything here is a copy stored on this device - it opens without a connection and stays even if the original page goes away.

download_failed.message: The download did not finish, and nothing was stored.

model_files_unknown_file.message: Not part of a model: $FILE$. Expected names starting with model., lex. and vocab.

model_files_unknown_pair.message: Cannot tell which languages this file is for: $FILE$.

model_files_not_a_model.message: Those files are not a translation model.

words_one.description: Plural family: the _one/_few/_many/_other suffixes follow Intl.PluralRules categories; a missing category falls back to _other.

options_local_intro.message: Everything re/read does happens on this device: translating, the dictionary, the reading list, your saved phrases. Nothing you read or select is ever sent anywhere. The only network this extension uses is the downloads on this page - a translation model you chose, or a dictionary, never without your press.

options_engine_value.message: Bergamot, inside the package - translates offline

options_reader_only_hint.message: With this on, selecting on an ordinary page offers one thing: open it in the reader. Translating, keeping and underlining happen there. On Android it starts on - a bubble over a selection and the phone's own copy menu fight for the same spot.

options_models_intro.message: A model is what turns one language into another, and there is one per direction. Mozilla builds and publishes them - the same models Firefox itself translates pages with. Nothing is translated until the model for the pair you are reading is here, on this device. Every direction Mozilla publishes is listed; the pair you are reading and anything already stored float to the top.

options_filter_models_aria.message: Filter the list of translation models

options_model_note_from.description: First third of the note around the host and date, which stand between the parts as page elements. Each part must read on from the last across a plain space - no part starts or ends with whitespace.

options_model_note_checked.message: - where Mozilla publishes them - at addresses written down in this package. Every file is checked against a checksum that was recorded here on

options_model_note_rest.message: - anything that does not match is thrown away rather than stored. Nothing about you is sent: the request says which model, and nothing else. This host and the dictionary catalogue's below are the only two places this extension ever contacts, and neither before you press Download.

options_add_model_intro.message: Pick the three files of one direction and they are stored locally. Gzipped files are unpacked here, so the downloads can be used as they come:

options_files_note.message: This page stays even once models download themselves: it is the way out on the day the place they are downloaded from stops answering. Nothing here leaves the device, and adding a model makes no network request at all.

options_dictionaries_intro.message: A dictionary answers what a translation cannot.

options_dict_example_word.description: A word with two unrelated meanings in this catalogue's language - each language picks its own.

options_dictionaries_intro_rest.message: has two entries, and a model has to choose one of them without knowing which you meant; a dictionary shows both. Entries appear in the second layer of the bubble, under the sentence.

options_wikdict_intro.message: builds dictionaries from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA) for every pair below. One press downloads the archive, unpacks it here and stores it; the languages are read off the pair, and the dictionary appears in the list above, ready to answer.
options_wikdict_intro.description: Follows the bolded name WikDict, which stands in the page as its own element.

options_dictionary_note_checked.message: - where WikDict publishes them - at addresses written down in this package; the list was checked here on

options_dictionary_note_rest.message: - unlike models there is no checksum to hold them to: WikDict rebuilds its files in place, so a sum recorded here would break with every rebuild. What stands in its place: the download must be a plain zip of StarDict files, it is read as warily as any file you would add by hand, and what it becomes is text in the local database - never code. Nothing about you is sent: the request says which dictionary, and nothing else.

options_stardict_intro.description: Followed by the bolded format name StarDict, then options_stardict_intro_rest.

options_stardict_intro_rest.message: format - the same files a KOReader e-reader uses, so a dictionary already on your reader works here unchanged. Unpack the archive it came in and pick the files of one dictionary:

options_file_syn.message: - other spellings, when the dictionary has them

options_dict_files_note.message: A StarDict file says nothing about which languages it is for, so here that part is yours to say. Adding from files makes no network request at all, and the path stays for the day the catalogue's host stops answering: files from anywhere work, the catalogue's own included - they are published at
options_dict_files_note.description: Ends just before the address, which stands in the page as a link; the sentence's closing full stop is part of the page.

options_disabled_intro.message: Sites where re/read stays off - no underlines, no bubble, nothing running. The switch in the toolbar popup is what adds a site here; this list is how one is turned back on without visiting it.

options_downloaded_model.message: Downloaded the $PAIR$ model, $SIZE$ on this device.

options_store_failed.message: The model downloaded but could not be stored: $DETAIL$

options_reading_pair_missing.message: Reading $FROM$, translating into $TO$ - and there is no model for this direction here yet.

options_no_models.message: No models here, and none to download - this build lists none.

options_filter_no_match_models.message: No pair matches that. The filter takes a language name or a code.

options_filter_no_match_dictionaries.message: No dictionary matches that. The filter takes a language name or a code.

options_no_disabled.message: No sites are switched off. The toolbar popup is where one is.

options_added_model.message: Added the $PAIR$ model, $SIZE$ on this device.

options_no_dictionaries.message: No dictionaries here. The bubble shows a translation and nothing else.

options_no_catalog.message: No dictionaries to download - this build lists none.

options_reading_dictionary_progress.description: DONE arrives with its unit already counted ("12,000 words"); TOTAL is a bare number.

options_skipped_entries_one.message: $COUNT$ entry could not be read and was left out.

options_skipped_entries_other.message: $COUNT$ entries could not be read and were left out.

options_swept_unfinished.message: Removed a dictionary that was never finished importing ($NAMES$).
